name: gku-hud
description: A pane beside the chat for gku's working files: the task files in .tasks/ with how many steps are ticked, and the reports in .gku/reports/, newest first. Select one to read it; a button puts the next /gku command into the prompt for you to send. Reads only: it writes no file and starts no turn. Needs Claude Code with mods (2.1.316 or later).

open.title: Open at start
open.description: Open the pane when a session starts (placed from 144 columns; /gku-hud:tasks opens it at any width), or only when asked.
